info.name: The Muppets Mayhem Band
info.plot: Dopo 45 anni di rock and roll gli Electric Mayhem si imbarcano in un epico viaggio musicale per registrare finalmente il loro primo album in studio. Con l’aiuto di una giovane ed entusiasta produttrice, l’iconica rock band dei Muppet, dal fascino senza tempo – con Dott. Denti, Sgt. Floyd Pepper, Janice, Lips, Zoot e Animal – deve mettersi in marcia e affrontare la pazza scena musicale contemporanea per vincere il disco di platino.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: A driven music exec convinces the iconic rockers of The Electric Mayhem to make their first album.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Nora's exaggerated promises jeopardize her role with the band and threaten lie-detecting Janice.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: La band fatica a trovare il proprio ritmo durante le registrazioni nel moderno studio di un famoso produttore.

translations.value: La band fatica a trovare il proprio ritmo durante le registrazioni nel moderno studio di un famoso produttore.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: On a quest to find the band's "new sound" with different collaborators, Nora butts heads with Moog.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Looking for inspiration, Nora takes the band on a desert road trip where they find more than music.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Dr. Teeth's parents arrive, questioning his destiny and jeopardizing both the album and the band.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Nora and JJ team up to create a Beatles-inspired documentary about the band's album-making process.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: The band's foray into social media goes awry as they prepare to play a virtual video game concert.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Consumed by their new solo pursuits, the band makes a shocking announcement on a live radio show.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: All seems lost when Nora fails to reunite The Electric Mayhem for a concert at the Hollywood Bowl.

The Electric Mayhem Band goes on an epic musical journey to finally record their first studio album. With the help of a driven young music executive, Nora, the old-school Muppet band comes face to face with the current day music scene as they try to finally go platinum.
